Compare diets along a continuous effect with MixSIAR's

Source: R/compare.R
plot_compare_covariate.Rd

Each consumer's diet posterior (mean and 95% interval) from MixSIARPFN against MixSIAR's (p.ind), plotted against the consumer's value of the continuous effect, one panel per source.

Usage

plot_compare_covariate(fit, pind, cont = fit$cont_effects[1], by = NULL)

Arguments

fit

The output of run_pfn(), for a model with a continuous effect.

pind

MixSIAR's per-consumer diets: mixsiar_reference(...)$pind, or a data frame with columns consumer, source, mean, q2.5, q97.5 and the covariate.

cont

The continuous effect (default: the model's first).

by

Optional: a factor of the model (a column of pind) to split the panels by, when the diet depends on it as well as on the covariate.

Value

A ggplot.
